lag_1h_nat_demand.description: nat_demand value 1 hour(s) before the forecast origin t (i.e. value at t-1h).
lag_1h_nat_demand.leakage_note: Uses only past data (t-1h <= t). Safe: no information from after origin t.

lag_24h_nat_demand.description: nat_demand value 24 hour(s) before the forecast origin t (i.e. value at t-24h).
lag_24h_nat_demand.leakage_note: Uses only past data (t-24h <= t). Safe: no information from after origin t.

lag_48h_nat_demand.description: nat_demand value 48 hour(s) before the forecast origin t (i.e. value at t-48h).
lag_48h_nat_demand.leakage_note: Uses only past data (t-48h <= t). Safe: no information from after origin t.

lag_168h_nat_demand.description: nat_demand value 168 hour(s) before the forecast origin t (i.e. value at t-168h).
lag_168h_nat_demand.leakage_note: Uses only past data (t-168h <= t). Safe: no information from after origin t.

lag_0h_nat_demand.description: nat_demand value at the forecast origin t itself (most recent known actual).
lag_0h_nat_demand.leakage_note: Value at t is known when standing at t and forecasting t+24h. Safe.

roll_mean_24h_nat_demand.description: Rolling mean of nat_demand over the trailing 24 hours ending at (and including) origin t.
roll_mean_24h_nat_demand.leakage_note: min_periods=window enforced so no partial/undefined window is silently filled; window is strictly [t-w+1, t]. Safe.

roll_std_24h_nat_demand.description: Rolling std of nat_demand over the trailing 24 hours ending at (and including) origin t.
roll_std_24h_nat_demand.leakage_note: Same trailing window as the corresponding rolling mean. Safe.

roll_mean_168h_nat_demand.description: Rolling mean of nat_demand over the trailing 168 hours ending at (and including) origin t.
roll_mean_168h_nat_demand.leakage_note: min_periods=window enforced so no partial/undefined window is silently filled; window is strictly [t-w+1, t]. Safe.

roll_std_168h_nat_demand.description: Rolling std of nat_demand over the trailing 168 hours ending at (and including) origin t.
roll_std_168h_nat_demand.leakage_note: Same trailing window as the corresponding rolling mean. Safe.

target_hour_of_day.description: Hour of day (0-23) at the target timestamp t+24h.
target_hour_of_day.leakage_note: Calendar arithmetic is deterministic and known infinitely far in advance for any future timestamp. Not leakage.

target_day_of_week.description: Day of week (0=Mon..6=Sun) at the target timestamp t+24h.
target_day_of_week.leakage_note: Calendar arithmetic is deterministic and known infinitely far in advance for any future timestamp. Not leakage.

target_month.description: Calendar month (1-12) at the target timestamp t+24h.
target_month.leakage_note: Calendar arithmetic is deterministic and known infinitely far in advance for any future timestamp. Not leakage.

target_is_weekend.description: 1 if the target timestamp falls on Saturday/Sunday, else 0.
target_is_weekend.leakage_note: Calendar arithmetic is deterministic and known infinitely far in advance for any future timestamp. Not leakage.

target_hour_sin.description: Sine-encoded hour of day at target timestamp (cyclical encoding).
target_hour_sin.leakage_note: Calendar arithmetic is deterministic and known infinitely far in advance for any future timestamp. Not leakage.

target_hour_cos.description: Cosine-encoded hour of day at target timestamp (cyclical encoding).
target_hour_cos.leakage_note: Calendar arithmetic is deterministic and known infinitely far in advance for any future timestamp. Not leakage.

target_dow_sin.description: Sine-encoded day of week at target timestamp (cyclical encoding).
target_dow_sin.leakage_note: Calendar arithmetic is deterministic and known infinitely far in advance for any future timestamp. Not leakage.

target_dow_cos.description: Cosine-encoded day of week at target timestamp (cyclical encoding).
target_dow_cos.leakage_note: Calendar arithmetic is deterministic and known infinitely far in advance for any future timestamp. Not leakage.

target_month_sin.description: Sine-encoded month at target timestamp (cyclical encoding).
target_month_sin.leakage_note: Calendar arithmetic is deterministic and known infinitely far in advance for any future timestamp. Not leakage.

target_month_cos.description: Cosine-encoded month at target timestamp (cyclical encoding).
target_month_cos.leakage_note: Calendar arithmetic is deterministic and known infinitely far in advance for any future timestamp. Not leakage.

target_holiday_id.description: Holiday_ID (categorical) at the target timestamp t+24h, looked up from the dataset's own calendar column.
target_holiday_id.leakage_note: Holiday/school calendars are published in advance and are deterministic lookups by date, not measured outcomes. Rows where target_dt falls beyond the raw data's max timestamp become NaN and are dropped along with the undefined target (see rows-lost accounting).

target_holiday_flag.description: Binary holiday flag at the target timestamp t+24h.
target_holiday_flag.leakage_note: Holiday/school calendars are published in advance and are deterministic lookups by date, not measured outcomes. Rows where target_dt falls beyond the raw data's max timestamp become NaN and are dropped along with the undefined target (see rows-lost accounting).

target_school_flag.description: Binary school-in-session flag at the target timestamp t+24h.
target_school_flag.leakage_note: Holiday/school calendars are published in advance and are deterministic lookups by date, not measured outcomes. Rows where target_dt falls beyond the raw data's max timestamp become NaN and are dropped along with the undefined target (see rows-lost accounting).

origin_hour_of_day.description: Hour of day (0-23) at the forecast origin t.
origin_hour_of_day.leakage_note: Origin-time values are known at prediction time by definition. Safe.

origin_day_of_week.description: Day of week (0=Mon..6=Sun) at the forecast origin t.
origin_day_of_week.leakage_note: Origin-time values are known at prediction time by definition. Safe.

origin_holiday_flag.description: Binary holiday flag at the forecast origin t (from raw data, unmodified).
origin_holiday_flag.leakage_note: Origin-time values are known at prediction time by definition. Safe.

origin_school_flag.description: Binary school-in-session flag at the forecast origin t (from raw data, unmodified).
origin_school_flag.leakage_note: Origin-time values are known at prediction time by definition. Safe.

target_nat_demand_t_plus_24h.description: PREDICTION TARGET: nat_demand value 24 hours after the forecast origin t. This is the label, never a feature.
target_nat_demand_t_plus_24h.leakage_note: This is the label being predicted -- by construction it is the only column drawn from strictly after origin t, and it is excluded from the feature set at model-training time.
